tools.description: Apply an hdf-amendments document to an HDF results document, deterministically producing a NEW results file with effectiveStatus/effectiveImpact/disposition computed — the results input is NEVER overwritten. The applied file retains statusOverrides[] with appliedBy, so attribution and agent-override counts survive on the results artifact itself. Returns the before/after projected compliance, the changed-requirement count, and a reusable handle — never the document body. Writes under the shared write model (dry_run returns the delta without writing; a writes-disabled deployment returns a preview). Output that does not validate as hdf-results is refused.

amendments.description: the hdf-amendments document to apply, as {path} or {handle}

dryRun.description: with output set, preview the write (return the delta, write no file)

output.description: path under HDF_MCP_ROOT to write the applied results (a NEW file; the results input is never overwritten)

overwrite.description: replace an existing output file (default false)

results.description: the HDF results document to apply amendments to, as {path} or {handle}

tools.name: hdf_apply_amendment

tools.description: Author an HDF document from model-supplied structured content and return a summary plus a reusable handle — never the document body. docType is system (components), plan (assessments), evidence (contents), or amendments (overrides). For amendments the server holds field authority: the judgment path (content[] of overrides) stamps appliedBy.type=agent + appliedAt and requires expiresAt on each; the from_vex path (source = a VEX document + expiresAt) derives overrides and stamps appliedBy.type=system. Per-item shapes: the compact hdf://schema/{docType}/{def} slices, not the whole schema. Output that does not validate is refused. Writes under the shared write model (dry_run previews; a writes-disabled deployment returns a preview).

content.description: content array: components/assessments/contents, or overrides (amendments judgment path). Per-item shape: the hdf://schema/{docType}/{def} slice (e.g. hdf://schema/hdf-amendments/Standalone_Override), not the whole schema. The server validates and refuses invalid content.

docType.description: document to author: system, plan, evidence, or amendments

dryRun.description: with output set, preview the write (write no file)

expiresAt.description: amendments from_vex only: RFC3339 expiry applied to every derived override

output.description: path under HDF_MCP_ROOT to write the document

overwrite.description: replace an existing output file (default false)

source.description: amendments from_vex only: a VEX document as {path}; overrides are derived and stamped appliedBy.type=system

tools.name: hdf_author

tools.description: Compute aggregate percent compliance and status/severity rollups (by effective status: impact-0 is Not Applicable and excluded from the denominator, overrides honored) for an HDF results document, with an optional grouped breakdown and threshold verdict. counts is aggregate — for per-requirement status use hdf_query. counts uses SAF threshold-file keys: skipped = notReviewed, no_impact = notApplicable. The agentOverrides block is the detective surface: agent-attributed override count and the compliance delta they account for.

threshold.description: threshold spec: {path} to a YAML/JSON file, or {inline} object

path.description: path to a YAML/JSON threshold file under HDF_MCP_ROOT

tools.name: hdf_compliance

tools.description: Convert source security-tool output into an HDF results document and return a compact SUMMARY plus a reusable handle — never the converted body. from is auto-detected (incl NDJSON) when omitted. Batch mode: pass sources[] and/or directory to convert many files in one call, returning a per-file summary array (continue-past-failure unless failFast). With output/outputDir it writes under the shared write model (dryRun previews; writes-disabled returns a preview). Output failing hdf-results validation is refused.

directory.description: batch: a dir under HDF_MCP_ROOT to convert

failFast.description: batch: stop at the first failure

from.description: source format (e.g. nessus, gosec); auto-detected when omitted

outputDir.description: batch: dir under HDF_MCP_ROOT for outputs

pattern.description: batch: glob for directory (default all files)

tools.name: hdf_convert

tools.description: Compare two HDF documents: temporal (results across time) or system-drift (system documents). Returns a summary and a bounded change list; with output set, writes an hdf-comparison document.

dryRun.description: with output set, preview the write (return the summary + sha256, write no file)

mode.description: temporal (results across time, default) or system-drift (system docs)

output.description: path under HDF_MCP_ROOT to write the hdf-comparison document

overwrite.description: replace an existing output file (default false)

page.description: 0-based page when the change list is truncated

tools.name: hdf_diff

tools.description: Inspect an HDF document's structure and metadata for any of the eight document types (counts, inventories, envelopes) — never a requirement collection. To list requirements, use hdf_query.

section.description: one structural section (validity depends on doc type)

tools.name: hdf_inspect

tools.description: Open an HDF document: detect its type, validate it, mint a reusable handle, and return a headline summary. Optional first hop for a multi-question session; a one-shot path call also works.

source.description: the document to open, as {path} or {handle}

tools.name: hdf_open

tools.description: Filter requirements in an HDF results or baseline document. The only path to a requirement collection; for other document types call hdf_inspect.

id.description: requirement/STIG ID, GID, or group title

tools.name: hdf_query

tools.description: Validate an HDF document in one of three modes: schema (JSON-Schema conformance for any of the eight document types, with line-numbered errors), checksums (verify an evidence package's referenced-file sha256 checksums), or completeness (verify every planned baseline has results). The checksums and completeness modes also report the agent-attributed override count across the package's results.

content.description: inline HDF document to validate, as an alternative to source

docType.description: optional document type to validate against in schema mode (e.g. hdf-results); defaults to the detected type

mode.description: validation mode: schema, checksums, or completeness

source.description: the document to validate, as {path} or {handle}; omit when using content

tools.name: hdf_validate
